review.posthog_relevance: PostHog Conversations extension availability and cold-start behavior
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H1 replaces a check for the existence of the `conversations` facade with a check for the availability of the underlying manager. This prevents the UI from rendering an empty list and retrying on cold page loads, addressing a specific correctness and user experience issue. P1.F1.H2 is noted as the substantive implementation but is not provided in the supplied
review.uncertainty: The score relies on the description of P1.F1.H2 rather than its code, and P1.F1.H1 is described as documentation-only, though the provided observation suggests it contains the relevant behavior. The tier is assigned based on the described bounded correctness improvement, not unverified adoption or broader systemic changes.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 are both located in the same file and address the same underlying issue: the PostHog Conversations extension loading lazily. P1.F1.H2 is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement. P1.F1.H1 is a documentation-only change. P1.F1.H2 is the relevant implementation. P1.F1.H1 is not relevant to the score.

observations.behavior: Replaces a truthiness check on the existence of the `conversations` facade with a check on the availability of the underlying manager, preventing a cold-page load from rendering an empty list and never retrying.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks the availability of the PostHog Conversations extension before attempting to use it, rather than just checking if the facade object exists.
